BusinessUsers.title: Users
BusinessUsers.description: People who work in your organization. Only you can add or remove them.
BusinessUsers.createDescription: They'll sign in with this email and password, and join your organization.
BusinessUsers.emptyDescription: Add the people who work with you.
BusinessUsers.removeDescription: Their account, any leases and notes are deleted and they're signed out everywhere. Users with recorded rent payments can't be removed. This can't be undone.

hints.business: Owns an organization and creates user accounts inside it.
hints.user: Belongs to a business's organization and creates no accounts.
hints.admin: Runs the platform: manages every account, role and suspension.

warnings.business: They'll be asked to set up an organization the next time they sign in. Any business they already belong to as a user is unaffected.
warnings.user: They lose the ability to create accounts. An organization they own stays as it is, and its other members keep access.
warnings.admin: They get full access to the admin dashboard, including changing roles and deleting accounts. Only do this for people you trust.
warnings.demoteAdmin: They lose access to the admin dashboard. Their role updates within a few minutes, and they can be made Admin again later.
